body: U+0023# 2026-10-04: #261 merged; final installs, heat runs, cleanupU+000AU+000AU+002A*Merge.** #261 merged as d0cd3b7a, and the owner's checkout was fast-forwarded. GitHub deleted the remote branch; the local branch and worktree are removed.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Installs, built from d0cd3b7a** (builds in `~/.mitosis/field-notes/meadow-sweep/device/final`):U+000AU+002D Note 10+: `field_notes_plain` (seeded: 1,006 days, 643 entries, onboarding done, keep-moving) and `field_notes_fresh` (never opened).U+000AU+002D Mac: `~/Applications/field_notes_plain.app` (seeded the same way) and `field_notes_fresh.app` (empty container).U+000AU+000AU+002A*Owner's MacBook Pro** (Mac16,8, 120 Hz, background windows, owner approved), two 10 s runs each, alternating:U+000AU+002D Main: noon 123.5 to 123.6 fps, midnight 123.5 fps, raster p50 3.5 to 3.6 ms.U+000AU+002D Pre-sweep: 123.1 to 124.8 fps.U+000AU+002D Scene images 123 MB against 40 MB. One midnight run showed a 247 ms sharpening frame.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Heat on the Mac.** 120 s rest, then 600 s noon and 600 s unfocused:U+000AU+002D 111 and 116 fps on average, with p99 16 to 17 ms.U+000AU+002D Two stalls of 2.2 s and 0.85 s, cause unknown.U+000AU+002D Thermal state nominal to fair from about 7 minutes in; pmset recorded no warnings. App CPU averaged 82% of a core, RSS under 178 MB. The battery read a flat 31.0 C while charging.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Heat on the Note 10+.** 300 s rest, then 600 s noon and 600 s unfocused:U+000AU+002D 28.5 C, then 36.5 C at 59.8 fps, then 41.2 C at 59.7 fps.U+000AU+002D Thermal status 0; the GPU cap read level 2 at the end with no frame-rate loss. PSS 246 to 252 MB.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Owner judgments.** "I tested the look previously. the s100 blur version looked good." Criterion 4 (glass) is done, and criterion 1 (366 flowers smooth) is done from the phone, real-Mac and VM numbers.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Cleanup.** Probe apps and bench-container data went to `~/.Trash/field-notes-apps-2026-10-03/`; worktrees wt-final, wt-fix and water-marks-layer are removed. No lab instances are running.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Remaining.** Criterion 2 (sharpening hitch) and criterion 6 (owner's heat judgment).
